Forward Looking Statements This press release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, including, but not limited to, statements regarding: potential FDA approval and commercial launch of bezuclastinib in GIST; potential FDA approval of bezuclastinib in both NonAdvSM and AdvSM; cash runway expected to fund operations into late 2028 and well past all three pending PDUFA action dates for bezuclastinib; plans to submit INDs for the company’s JAK2 and KRAS pipeline programs and to move into clinical development soon; plans to complete dose escalation for CGT4255; and plans to present multiple poster presentations featuring bezuclastinib at ASH 2026 and the contents of those presentations.
